$messageId..write:
auth != null &&
            new_data.hasChildren(['conversationId', 'conversationType', 'senderId', 'text', 'target', 'mentionedUserIds', 'createdAt']) &&
            new_data.child('senderId').val() === auth.uid &&
            (new_data.child('conversationType').val() === 'direct' || new_data.child('conversationType').val() === 'group') &&
            new_data.child('text').val().isString() &&
            new_data.child('text').val().length() > 0 &&
            new_data.child('text').val().length() <= 1000 &&
            new_data.child('mentionedUserIds').val().isArray() &&
            (new_data.child('target').child('type').val() === 'conversation' ||
             (new_data.child('target').child('type').val() === 'member' && new_data.child('target').child('memberId').val().isString()))
